principles: collection and source interaction belong to the Intelligence Center
bounded deterministic algorithms belong to the Compute Center
raw evidence is transferred only by GPTs with provenance and integrity metadata
a Python package may exist in both repositories only when its runtime role is explicitly different
no arbitrary code, runtime dependency selection, hidden model calls or autonomous loops

owns: statistics, probability, econometrics and causal estimation on supplied data
optimization, simulation, forecasting, uncertainty analysis and sensitivity analysis
game theory, negotiation, agent-based models and bounded strategic sandboxes
graph metrics, link analysis, ontology constraint checks and evidence-graph computation
entity-resolution scoring, fuzzy comparison and set-similarity algorithms after record preparation
financial mathematics, portfolio risk, business analytics and policy microsimulation
forecast scoring, calibration, interval validation, realized-outcome feedback and VV&A
generic offline state estimation with no live feed, identity, target or weapons integration
external API, web, browser, feed, document and public-dataset collection
provider authentication, rate limits, host allowlists and read-only request execution
HTML, PDF, OCR and structured-document extraction
source registration, immutable snapshots, provenance, hashes and evidence packaging
raw record normalization, schema mapping, deduplication preparation and data minimization
STIX or TAXII exchange, public cyber-threat feeds and source-level temporal versioning
evidence archives, public-data lineage and transfer packages for GPTs

RDFLib.intelligence_center: construct and serialize provenance or evidence records
RDFLib.compute_center: run graph queries, constraints, inference summaries and link metrics

RapidFuzz_and_datasketch.intelligence_center: prepare normalized records and candidate blocks
RapidFuzz_and_datasketch.compute_center: calculate bounded similarity and collision scores

pandas_and_Polars.intelligence_center: normalize collected records into transfer schemas
pandas_and_Polars.compute_center: perform bounded analysis on supplied transfer tables

prohibited_everywhere: unlawful surveillance or covert personal targeting
real-time person or military target tracking
persuasion targeting, influence operations or automated enforcement
offensive cyber exploitation or malware deployment
weapons-effects modeling, autonomous engagement or operational command
live brokerage execution, automated trading or guaranteed-profit claims
